inputs.name: resume_discovery
inputs.size_bound: one invocation-local no_resumable_state result bound to the checked repository and scope

failures.recovery: Ask for the missing decisive signal only when it changes the route.
Report bounded classification with the open signal recorded.

effects.ceiling: in-context reasoning only; no side effects

determinism.canonical_serialization: one recorded classification line: horizon, decisive signals, route, profile boundary
determinism.nondeterminism_notes: Model judgment over ambiguous requests; ambiguity resolves to bounded unless a durable-evidence signal is present.

authority.author: rahulskills
human_gates: Escalate only when stated outcome and observed effect classes conflict, or when ratifying a design-only boundary.
ceiling: classification and routing statements; no execution

acceptance_checks: Continuation routing preserves the existing scope, policy, budget and stop conditions without reducing a multi-epoch grant to one iteration.
Routing decision names horizon, decisive signals, selected route, and any profile-check boundary.

Fast path is owned by continue-work: a supplied continuation handoff is delegated there and its direct design-owner decision preserves scope, policy, budget and stop conditions; an exhausted batch or expanding envelope routes to the principal.

Resume discovery is delegated to continue-work exactly once; intake consumes a same-repository/scope no_resumable_state result to classify a genuine new statement or ask once when none exists, and never cycles back without changed relevant state or a new invocation.
artifact_provenance: one recorded line in the session, reusable by downstream skills
evidence.report_boundary: A route is a recommendation to the caller, not an effect grant.
